$comment: Contract for GET https://restful-booker.herokuapp.com/booking/{id}. Note this is the UNWRAPPED booking object - POST /booking returns {bookingid, booking:{...}}, but GET /booking/{id} returns the booking fields directly at the top level. Mixing those two shapes up is a real, easy mistake - this schema exists partly to catch exactly that mistake if a sheet author points it at the wrong response.
